title: Politically Speaking: LLMs on Changing International Affairs

bias_targets.methodology: Using role-play prompting to ask LLMs to impersonate political experts from different countries (US, Russia, China, Iran) and evaluating the ideological homogenization of their responses using textual similarity metrics including TF-IDF, SBERT, Jaccard, Levenshtein, and Word Mover's Distance.

Prompting LLMs in English versus the native languages of the impersonated experts (Chinese, Russian, Farsi) and measuring how the input language affects output diversity and the degree of narrative convergence.

Comparing generated political commentary across different assigned national identities to determine if the models can genuinely represent diverse national perspectives or if they default to a homogenized, Western-centric worldview.
